learning_outcomes.text: Address data management problems using the most appropriate technologies and conduct database projects using appropriate methodologies.
Knowledge of data representation models, database management systems, languages for interacting with databases, and methodologies for designing relational databases.
Understanding of data models different from the relational model and mechanisms for applications and databases to interact.

Be able to create software that interacts with relational databases and be able to design relational databases using appropriate methodologies that ensure the correctness and efficiency of what has been implemented.
Be able to evaluate the correctness of a database schema and the efficiency of a database against information on the application load that will weigh on the data.

The design activities and exercises of the course allow the student to be able to communicate/share the requirements of a database, as well as the design choices and methodologies for its design and development.

In addition to the classic learning abilities provided by the theoretical study of teaching material, the course delivery methods, in particular the design activities, stimulate the student to independently explore new database models, new data query languages, and new systems for their management.

degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
